title: Receipt
description: Execution receipt returned by the executor (src/executor/mod.rs Receipt). A receipt is honest evidence of what happened: status reflects the outcome, dry-run plans carry status "plan", deduplicated calls return the stored prior receipt untouched.

status.description: Outcome status. One of: success, failure, simulated, plan, not_allowed, invalid.

idempotency_key.description: Effective idempotency key (SHA-256 hex) under which this receipt is stored.

detail.description: Human-readable evidence of the side effect (e.g. docker compose up command line, or "no side effect (simulated) for tool …").

exit.description: Process exit code for real adapters, 0 for simulated/plan.
